'''Tvinnii Blackrunn''' was a member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime cartel who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Black Sun formed an alliance with the [[Detritus Satellites]], a group of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droids]] active in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. Blackrunn and the droid [[X10-700 "Destroyer"]] were the signers of the alliance agreement.<ref name="SWG:AAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tvinnii Blackrunn was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AAA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of Tvinnii Blackrunn was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. In the space part of the game, rare information storage devices can sometimes be [[Wikipedia:Looting (gaming)|looted]] from destroyed [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. One of these [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], named "[[W:c:swg:An Alliance Agreement|An Alliance Agreement]]," can be found in the Dantooine system and contains the text of an agreement signed by Blackrunn.<ref name="SWG:AAA" />
